messages.body:
Dear community,
Some time ago I posted this issue and so far I haven't found a solution. Could any of you help me solving it? It's been months since we acquired AMBER without the possibility to use it. I would appreciate your support.
Best regards,
Freddy
>>> Freddy Bernal 01.03.2023 12:34 >>>

The log file is below. The diff file can be downloaded from
https://nextcloud.hki-jena.de/index.php/s/LFs2BB5FmS2LmBs
I hope you can help me.
Best regards,
Freddy

installing gcc10 or gcc11 to see if that helps.
